Actor.description:
Who wrote a record or acted: the session, the program, the person and
the agent's name, each when known, and at least one. Every record type that names who
acted holds one.

agent.description:
The name the agent was given, such as `nightly scheduler`, as
free text.

person.description: The person who acted, such as `luke`, or their email address.

program.description: The program that acted, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

description:
`changes/reopen/v1`: one move of a change back to build for a fix
round, and why.

It lives at `/changes/<name>/reopens/<stamp>`. `changes.reopen` writes
it with the change, and `next` shows the newest one's reason while the
change is in build.

reason.description: Why the change went back to build.

title: ReopenRecord
